title: RecordHeader key() is not thread safe

comments.author: chia7712
comments.body: Not only the key, but also the value is not thread-safe. This is the expected behavior. Could you please share your use case?

comments.author: fxbing
comments.body: [~chia7712] In my usage, one thread records the consumed messages as map key (Record.hashCode) and performs some processing, while another thread records some metrics through the RecordHeaders.lastHeader() method

changelog.to: This issue is fixed by KAFKA-12999
